rules_applied: Classification: Has power boiler → POWER (电力生产)

SO2 coal: Mass balance EF = 20 * S% * (1 - 0.15)
NOx coal heat supply: 8.85 (煤粉炉), 7.5 (流化床炉), 4 (层燃炉) g/kg
PM coal: Mass balance EF = 10 * Ash% * (1-ar) * f_PM
CO, VOC, BC, OC: Table D.1 values
NH3: Not in power sector EF table → not_involved
Control efficiency: Appendix A with fuzzy matching from B101-2002 facility names
Low-NOx burner: 22% NOx reduction if no other NOx control
Gas fuel EFs in g/m³, solid/liquid fuel EFs in g/kg
